description: This file defines a static class 'PageSizeConverter' that provides a method to convert various PageSize enumerations into pixel dimensions in XSize. It is part of the PDFsharp library for handling PDF documents, specifically for converting page sizes to represent them in pixel sizes based on certain standards.

classes.name: PageSizeConverter
classes.description: A static utility class to convert PageSize enum values into XSize pixel dimensions.

methods.name: ToSize
methods.description: Converts a PageSize enumeration into a corresponding XSize object with pixel dimensions, based on predefined standards.
